# The Innkeeper Agency

> The Innkeeper Agency manages revenue for independent motels, inns, lodges and cabins with about 6 to 30 rooms. It takes over nightly pricing, online listings and photos, a direct booking website, and visibility in AI assistants. Owners pay nothing up front and 25 percent of the increase in room revenue for twelve months, measured on the occupancy tax returns they already file.

Founder: Adam Mealey, who previously owned and ran boutique lodging in California mountain towns.
Contact: (760) 582-5260, adam@theinnkeeperagency.com
Area served: California.

## Pages

- [Home](https://theinnkeeperagency.com/): what the agency does, what it costs, how it works, common questions.
- [For brokers](https://theinnkeeperagency.com/brokers.html): how hotel and business brokers can introduce an owner whose income does not yet support the price they want.

## What the agency does not do

It does not list, sell or value property, and it does not give legal or tax advice. It does not handle guests, staff or the owner's money.
